topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: Rain's been falling like it’s trying to wash the city clean, but it never does. Found a time capsule today, buried in a corner of the park where the shadows linger longer. It was sealed tight, but the weight of it ain't right. Inside, a stack of photos, letters, a few trinkets—all from a time I thought I'd locked away for good. Someone’s trying to pull me back into the past, maybe a warning, maybe a message. I can't shake the feeling that I’ve walked this path before, and it didn’t end pretty. I’m supposed to be past this, but the past has a funny way of catching up. The rain’s getting heavier, but I can’t seem to move. Maybe it’s time to start digging up some truths, even if they’re buried deeper than this capsule.
